descriptions.en: Drop a single APK file onto the NotchAny notch to install it on a connected Android device. The action reads the APK manifest to detect `debuggable` and `testOnly`; debug or test APKs require confirmation before `adb install -t` is used. When multiple eligible devices are connected, a target picker appears. Offline and unauthorized devices are excluded. Standard installations use `adb install -r` so existing apps can be replaced. Requires `adb` from Android Platform Tools.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 把单个 APK 文件拖入 NotchAny 刘海，即可安装到已连接的 Android 设备。动作会自动读取 APK Manifest，识别 `debuggable` 和 `testOnly`；遇到调试或测试包时先请求确认，再追加 `adb install -t`。连接多台可用设备时会显示目标选择框，并过滤 offline 或 unauthorized 设备。默认使用 `adb install -r`，支持覆盖安装。依赖 Android Platform Tools 中的 `adb`。

summaries.en: Drop an APK, choose an Android device, and install it through ADB.
summaries.zh-Hans: 拖入 APK，选择 Android 设备并自动完成 ADB 安装。
